propositions: Nested pytest child processes launched without explicit --basetemp join the user-global numbered temp root and trigger cleanup that deletes unrelated cleanup-eligible directories from sibling runs.

tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py::test_engine_submodules_resolve_when_the_tests_unit_shadow_is_active launches a mixed-module pytest child without a private basetemp, allowing it to clean shared numbered temp trees.

tests/unit/test_scripts_import_convention.py::test_repro_module_passes_standalone launches a bare console-script pytest child without a private basetemp, allowing it to clean shared numbered temp trees.
Parent pytest processes that pass a unique --basetemp derived from their own tmp_path fixture isolate child cleanup to that subtree and prevent deletion of unrelated temporary directories.

pytest 9.1.1 TempPathFactory.getbasetemp creates and registers cleanup for the numbered root; nested children without explicit --basetemp allocation trigger cleanup_numbered_dir at pytest_sessionfinish.
